title: ReTouch
subtitle: Keeps the touchscreen working while the car moves. Removes the driver-distraction protection: use at your own risk.
description: Keeps the touchscreen working while the car moves. It comments out the Global.AtSpeed handler in Common.js and sets the NVRAM keys bus_bcm_speed_restriction and lvds_speed_restriction to disable; uninstall puts the previous values back. WARNING: this mod removes the driver-distraction protection. You use it at your own risk; no claims are accepted. Idea from the MZD-AIO touchscreen tweak and TouchTune.
